persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: This phone pic of my dog came out blurry. Can you make it clearer and bigger, 640 pixels on the long side? Keep it looking natural.
bank.Enhancement style: Natural-looking blur reduction and sharpening, not a stylised remake.
bank.Size and framing: 640 pixels on the long side; preserve the original proportions and framing.
bank.Subject and background: Keep the same dog, pose, expression, and background.

messages.text: This pic of my dog came out blurry when I took it on my phone. I was a little disappointed because I really like this photo. Could you make it clearer and bigger, with 640 pixels on the long side? I’m fond of this dog, so even an ordinary photo like this means a lot to me. Please keep it looking natural.
